body.statement: Using the quotient-enumeration handle, determine whether every distinct tuple in \(\Theta_S(\mathcal O_S)\) can be emitted exactly once, together with a canonical inducing order and positive-definite noise certificate, in total \(O(\operatorname{poly}(p,m)2^p+\operatorname{poly}(p,m)N_{\mathrm{out}})\) exact-real arithmetic operations or with polynomial delay, without visiting every compatible source-to-sink path in \(\mathcal D_S\); if this complexity is impossible in the stated oracle model, derive a matching obstruction.
body.justification: This is the explicit residual computational question. The removed-set DAG compactly represents compatibility and the proved fiber lemma removes factorial duplication after a tuple is known, but neither result discovers all previously unknown numerical tuple fibers with additive subset-state and output work.
body.gap: GuoPerkovic2021MinimalEffects uses graphical effect signatures, WienobstEtAl2023MECEnumeration emits graph-distinct DAGs, WangEtAl2023EquivalenceEnumeration assumes a locally colored decomposable AND--OR congruence, and AvisFukuda1996ReverseSearch requires a locally searchable parent relation. None supplies the missing child oracle for equality of completed modified-Cholesky tuples.
body.consumer: A future resolution would upgrade the complete feasibility representation into a duplicate-free output-sensitive solver for degenerate systems; the present paper does not claim that algorithm or a hardness lower bound.

obligation.what_is_open: Construct a child oracle that discovers every coefficient-tuple fiber exactly once with additive subset-state and output cost, or formalize an oracle model and prove a matching lower bound.
obligation.obstruction: The fiber lemma canonicalizes inducing orders only after a tuple is known. A removed-set state can be an ideal of many different output support posets, while coefficient equality is determined by completed regression rows rather than by a frozen local edge color. Scanning every ideal for every output costs a product of the subset-state and output counts, and traversing all paths can still be factorial when there is only one output.
obligation.attempted: Canonical lexicographic paths, adjacent commuting-swap reduction, hashing completed paths, and reverse search were examined. Lexicographic minimality is only decidable after future parent coefficients are exposed; hashing retains factorial traversal; and reverse search lacks a polynomial-time inverse-child generator for branches accessible only through noncanonical inducing orders. No impossibility theorem is justified because the frozen handle does not specify a sufficiently formal query-oracle model.
obligation.partial_result: For every \(T\in\Theta_S(\mathcal O_S)\), the complete fiber of compatible inducing orders is exactly the set of linear extensions of \(G_T\). Thus factorial duplication inside a known fiber can be collapsed: the lexicographically least inducing order is obtained by greedy topological sorting, all inducing orders are connected by adjacent incomparable swaps, and \(\Gamma_\pi\succ0\) is then computed in polynomial time. This does not yet enumerate the previously unknown fibers with additive \(2^p+N_{\mathrm{out}}\) work.
